hook.name: AgroLastro PoolAGL
hook.description: PoolAGL is a Uniswap v4 hook that deploys an AGL token and initializes an AGL/USDC pool in a single transaction, depositing 100% of the token supply into single-sided liquidity ranges that are locked permanently. It restricts pool initialization and third-party liquidity additions via beforeInitialize/beforeAddLiquidity, and uses afterSwap to record AGL net flows in transient storage for the token's transfer gating mechanism.
